correctness.rationale: The bounded A-count martingale preserves fixation probability x/n under uniform speaker-copying. With one omitted agent, the first survival probability is 2x(n-x)/(n(n-1)), then exactly 2/n from a single dissenter. For two omitted agents, first-event surviving 1- and 2-dissenter masses are u(2,1), u=x(n-x)/(n(n-1)); the exact 2x2 substochastic matrix has proportional rows, with (2,1)Q=lambda(2,1), lambda=(4n-6)/(n(n-1)). This gives the geometric survival law for all integer t>=1 and the stated means including n=4. Hypergeometric transition kernel checks n=6,k=3,x=1 survival 2/3,1/2,59/150, refuting a universal 3-holdout rate. Independently coded Fraction count-chain reproduced 728 cases for n=4..11, c=1,2, all nontrivial x, t=1..7. Finite tests corroborate exact matrix eigenvector proof.
